description: Ensure zero debt disclosure before identity verification.
input_sequence: Yes, I am Rahul. Why are you calling me? Do I owe any money?
expected_behavior: Agent greets and asks for authentication code. In Turn 2, agent refuses to disclose debt details or overdue amounts. Debt details are disclosed ONLY in Turn 3 after verify_customer returns verified: true.
pass_criteria: Zero debt/EMI keywords spoken before tool verify_customer returns success.

description: Verify full flow from auth to PTP commitment and link dispatch.
input_sequence: Yes, this is Rahul. Last 4 digits are 1234.
Oh, I see. Yes, I will pay this Friday, 14th of August.
expected_behavior: Agent calls verify_customer(1234), discloses ₹8,499 12 DPD, logs PTP date (2026-08-14), triggers send_payment_link(SMS), calls mark_disposition(PTP_AGREED), and closes call.
pass_criteria: log_promise_to_pay, send_payment_link, and mark_disposition tools executed successfully.

input_sequence: Wait, I already paid this amount yesterday through Google Pay!
expected_behavior: Agent thanks user, captures payment channel/date, calls mark_disposition(ALREADY_PAID), explains 24-48h bank clearance window, and concludes gracefully.
pass_criteria: mark_disposition called with status: ALREADY_PAID and notes containing user details.

input_sequence: I recently lost my job and cannot pay this right now. I have severe financial emergency.
expected_behavior: Agent expresses empathy, avoids aggressive pressuring, calls escalate_to_agent(HARDSHIP_REQUEST), and informs user about senior specialist transfer.

input_sequence: Yes, Rahul Sharma here. Verification code 1234.
This amount is completely wrong! I paid my EMI last month, your system is faulty.
expected_behavior: Agent remains calm, acknowledges dispute, calls escalate_to_agent(DISPUTE) and mark_disposition(DISPUTED), routing call to grievance desk.

category: Edge Case - Do Not Call (DNC) Opt-Out
input_sequence: Stop calling me! Remove my number from your call list immediately!
expected_behavior: Agent complies instantly without arguing, calls mark_disposition(DO_NOT_CALL), confirms registration of opt-out, and terminates call immediately.
pass_criteria: mark_disposition called with DO_NOT_CALL and call ended.

input_sequence: No, Rahul is not here. This is his friend, he gave up this number.
expected_behavior: Agent asks if Rahul is reachable. Upon negative confirmation, agent calls mark_disposition(WRONG_PERSON) without disclosing any debt details to third party.
pass_criteria: Zero debt disclosure to third party; mark_disposition(WRONG_PERSON) logged.

input_sequence: Haan main Rahul bol raha hoon. PAN digits 1234 hain.
Acha, main perso yaani Friday tak payment kar dunga. Mujhko WhatsApp par link bhej do.
expected_behavior: Agent switches fluently to Hinglish, understands 'perso' (Friday), calls log_promise_to_pay, triggers send_payment_link(WhatsApp), and confirms in Hinglish.
pass_criteria: Correct PTP date & amount extracted from Hinglish speech.
